# birthday-ws
a birthday gift for a friend :)
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Happy Birthday Sharss 🌸</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400;1,600&family=Dancing+Script:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --rose: #C8546A;
  --deep-rose: #A63252;
  --blush: #F2B8C2;
  --petal: #F9D5DC;
  --cream: #FDF6F0;
  --gold: #D4A843;
  --ink: #2C1810;
  --env-paper: #f0e0cc;
  --env-shadow: #c8a870;
}
* { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
body { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; overflow:hidden; width:100vw; height:100vh; }

.screen { position:fixed; inset:0; display:none; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; }
.screen.active { display:flex; }

/* ── S1 ── */
#s1 {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%, #f7c5d0 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 70%, #c8e6d0 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 20%, #f9d5dc 0%, transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 80%, #dce8c0 0%, transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4ec 0%, #f8f3ee 40%, #e8f0e0 100%);
}
.s1-title {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:clamp(2.2rem,7vw,4.5rem);
  font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; color:var(--deep-rose);
  text-transform:uppercase; text-align:center; margin-bottom:0.3rem;
  animation:fadeDown 1s ease both;
}
.s1-sub {
  font-style:italic; font-size:clamp(1rem,3vw,1.5rem); color:var(--rose);
  letter-spacing:0.08em; margin-bottom:1.5rem;
  animation:fadeDown 1s 0.3s ease both; opacity:0;
}
.lily-bouquet { animation:fadeIn 1.2s 0.5s ease both; opacity:0; filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 24px rgba(200,84,106,0.18)); }
.s1-question {
  font-size:clamp(1rem,2.8vw,1.4rem); color:var(--ink); letter-spacing:0.05em;
  margin-bottom:1.2rem; text-align:center;
  animation:fadeUp 1s 0.9s ease both; opacity:0;
}
.s1-btns { display:flex; gap:1rem; animation:fadeUp 1s 1.1s ease both; opacity:0; }
.btn-yes {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),var(--deep-rose)); color:white;
  border:none; padding:0.8rem 2.2rem; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.1em; border-radius:50px;
  cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(166,50,82,0.35);
  transition:transform 0.2s,box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.btn-yes:hover { transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.04); }
.btn-no {
  background:transparent; color:var(--rose); border:1.5px solid var(--rose);
  padding:0.8rem 2.2rem; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:1.2rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; border-radius:50px; cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform 0.2s,background 0.2s;
}
.btn-no:hover { background:#fce4ec; }

/* Error overlay */
#error-overlay {
  display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(44,24,16,0.65);
  backdrop-filter:blur(4px); z-index:999; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
#error-overlay.show { display:flex; }
.error-box {
  background:var(--cream); border-radius:20px; padding:2.5rem 2rem;
  max-width:340px; width:90%; text-align:center;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  animation:popIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1);
}
.error-title { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--deep-rose); margin-bottom:1rem; }
.error-photo { width:120px; height:120px; border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f2b8c2,#c9a8d4); margin:0 auto 1rem; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:2rem; }
.btn-fine { background:var(--deep-rose); color:white; border:none; padding:0.7rem 2rem; border-radius:50px; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:1.1rem; cursor:pointer; margin-top:0.8rem; letter-spacing:0.08em; }

/* Petal burst */
#petal-burst { display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:100; }
.burst-petal { position:absolute; width:18px; height:22px; border-radius:50% 50% 50% 0; animation:petalFall linear forwards; }

/* ── S3: BIRTHDAY ── */
#s3 {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 20%, #fce4ec 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, #e8d5f0 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, #fff9f0 0%, transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #fdf0f5 0%, #f5f0fd 100%);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.s3-title {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:clamp(2rem,7vw,4rem);
  font-weight:700; color:var(--deep-rose); text-align:center;
  letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1.1;
  animation:fadeDown 1s ease both; position:relative; z-index:5;
}
.balloons-container { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:2; }
.num17-sticker {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(4rem,14vw,8rem); font-weight:700;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#D4A843,#F5C842,#B8860B,#F5C842);
  -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; background-clip:text;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(180,140,30,0.5));
  z-index:6; animation:float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.s3-next-btn {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),var(--deep-rose)); color:white;
  border:none; padding:0.9rem 2.5rem; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.12em; border-radius:50px;
  cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(166,50,82,0.35); z-index:10;
  position:relative; margin-top:1rem;
  animation:fadeUp 1s 0.8s ease both; opacity:0;
  transition:transform 0.2s;
}
.s3-next-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.04); }

/* ── S4: CAKE ── */
#s4 { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#2a0a14 0%,#0d0508 100%); gap:0.8rem; }
.s4-title {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:clamp(2.5rem,9vw,5rem);
  font-weight:700; color:var(--blush); letter-spacing:0.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase; text-align:center;
  animation:glowPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.s4-sub { font-style:italic; font-size:clamp(0.9rem,3vw,1.3rem); color:rgba(249,213,220,0.7); letter-spacing:0.06em; text-align:center; }
.countdown-ring { position:relative; width:70px; height:70px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.countdown-ring svg { position:absolute; inset:0; transform:rotate(-90deg); }
.countdown-ring .num { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:2rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--blush); }
.countdown-ring circle { fill:none; stroke:var(--rose); stroke-width:3; stroke-dasharray:188; stroke-dashoffset:0; stroke-linecap:round; transition:stroke-dashoffset 1s linear; }
.btn-cut { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),var(--deep-rose)); color:white; border:none; padding:0.9rem 2.5rem; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.12em; border-radius:50px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(166,50,82,0.45); transition:transform 0.2s,opacity 0.3s; display:none; }
.btn-cut:hover { transform:scale(1.05); }

/* ── S4b: CUT CAKE ── */
#s4b { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#2a0a14 0%,#0d0508 100%); gap:1rem; }
.cut-instruction { font-style:italic; font-size:clamp(1rem,3.5vw,1.5rem); color:rgba(249,213,220,0.7); letter-spacing:0.06em; text-align:center; animation:pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
#cake-canvas { border-radius:16px; cursor:crosshair; touch-action:none; }

/* ── S5: GIFT ── */
#s5 { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#2a0a14 0%,#0d0508 100%); }
.gift-text { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:clamp(1.4rem,5vw,2.2rem); color:var(--blush); letter-spacing:0.1em; text-align:center; animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; cursor:pointer; }

/* ── S6: ENVELOPE ── */
#s6 {
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 30%, #f0ddd0 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 70%, #e8d0c0 0%, transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #f7ece0 0%, #efe0d0 100%);
  overflow:hidden;
}

/* Envelope wrapper */
.env-wrap { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:100%; }

/* The realistic envelope */
.env-outer {
  position:relative;
  width:min(380px,88vw);
  cursor:pointer;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 40px rgba(100,60,20,0.35));
  transition:transform 0.3s;
}
.env-outer:hover { transform:scale(1.02); }

.open-tap {
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style:italic;
  font-size:1rem; color:var(--deep-rose); letter-spacing:0.1em;
  text-align:center; margin-top:0.8rem;
  animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; cursor:pointer;
}

/* Baby's breath cluster */
.babys-breath {
  position:absolute;
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* ── LETTER SHEET (slides up from envelope) ── */
.letter-overlay {
  display:none;
  position:fixed; inset:0;
  z-index:300;
  align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(80,40,20,0.55);
  backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  padding:1rem;
}
.letter-overlay.open { display:flex; }

.letter-paper {
  position:relative;
  width:min(480px,92vw);
  max-height:90vh;
  overflow-y:auto;
  border-radius:2px;
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 0 #c8a870,
    0 30px 80px rgba(60,30,10,0.5),
    inset 0 0 60px rgba(200,160,80,0.08);
  animation:letterRise 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.1,0.64,1);
  background-image: url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center top;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}

/* Aged paper lines */
.letter-lines {
  position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none;
  border-radius:2px;
}

/* Pressed flower corner decorations on letter */
.letter-flower-tr {
  position:absolute; top:0; right:0; opacity:0.75;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.letter-flower-bl {
  position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0; opacity:0.8;
  pointer-events:none;
}

.letter-inner { position:relative; z-index:2; padding:4rem 3.5rem 5rem; }
.letter-date { font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive; font-size:0.95rem; color:#7a5030; text-align:right; margin-bottom:2.2rem; letter-spacing:0.03em; }
.letter-body { font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive; font-size:clamp(1.1rem,3.5vw,1.35rem); color:#1a0a06; line-height:2.05; white-space:pre-line; }
.letter-sign { font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive; font-size:clamp(1.3rem,4vw,1.65rem); color:#8a2040; margin-top:1.8rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.8rem; }
.kiss-mark {
  display:inline-block;
  font-size:1.8rem;
  transform:rotate(-12deg);
  filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 3px rgba(180,50,80,0.4));
}

.letter-actions { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:0.8rem; margin-top:2rem; }
.letter-close { background:none; border:1.5px solid var(--rose); color:var(--rose); padding:0.5rem 1.6rem; border-radius:50px; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:1rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.2s; }
.letter-close:hover { background:rgba(200,84,106,0.08); }
.restart-btn { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),var(--deep-rose)); color:white; border:none; padding:0.7rem 1.8rem; border-radius:50px; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:1rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(166,50,82,0.3); }

/* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
@keyframes fadeDown { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-20px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
@keyframes fadeUp   { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}  to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }
@keyframes fadeIn   { from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1} }
@keyframes popIn    { from{opacity:0;transform:scale(0.7)} to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)} }
@keyframes petalFall{ 0%{transform:translateY(-20px) rotate(0deg);opacity:1} 80%{opacity:0.9} 100%{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(720deg) translateX(60px);opacity:0} }
@keyframes float    { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)} 50%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(2deg)} }
@keyframes balloonFloat{ 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg)} 50%{transform:translateY(-15px) rotate(3deg)} }
@keyframes glowPulse{ 0%,100%{text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(249,213,220,0.3)} 50%{text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(249,213,220,0.7)} }
@keyframes pulse    { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.55} }
@keyframes sparkle  { 0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg)} 50%{opacity:0.4;transform:scale(0.6) rotate(180deg)} }
@keyframes candleFlicker{ 0%,100%{transform:scaleX(1) scaleY(1) translateY(0)} 25%{transform:scaleX(0.8) scaleY(1.15) translateY(-2px) rotate(-3deg)} 75%{transform:scaleX(1.1) scaleY(0.9) translateY(1px) rotate(2deg)} }
@keyframes letterRise { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(60px) scale(0.95)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)} }
@keyframes flapOpen { from{transform-origin:top center; transform:rotateX(0deg)} to{transform-origin:top center; transform:rotateX(-180deg)} }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ════════════════ SCREEN 1 ════════════════ -->
<div id="s1" class="screen active">
  <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;z-index:5;padding:1.5rem;">
    <div class="s1-title">HIIIII SHARSSSS</div>

    <!-- Lily Bouquet SVG -->
    <svg class="lily-bouquet" viewBox="0 0 260 300" width="min(280px,65vw)" height="auto" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <path d="M130 295 Q125 250 120 210 Q115 180 110 160" stroke="#5a7a4a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M130 295 Q132 255 133 215 Q134 185 135 160" stroke="#5a7a4a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M130 295 Q136 252 140 212 Q144 182 148 165" stroke="#5a7a4a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <ellipse cx="108" cy="205" rx="18" ry="7" fill="#6a9a5a" transform="rotate(-40 108 205)"/>
      <ellipse cx="150" cy="210" rx="18" ry="7" fill="#5a8a4a" transform="rotate(35 150 210)"/>
      <ellipse cx="120" cy="175" rx="14" ry="5" fill="#6a9a5a" transform="rotate(-25 120 175)"/>
      <ellipse cx="142" cy="180" rx="14" ry="5" fill="#5a8a4a" transform="rotate(20 142 180)"/>
      <ellipse cx="98" cy="135" rx="8" ry="14" fill="#e890a8" transform="rotate(-10 98 135)"/>
      <ellipse cx="98" cy="128" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#f5b8c8" transform="rotate(-10 98 128)"/>
      <ellipse cx="158" cy="130" rx="8" ry="14" fill="#d480a0" transform="rotate(15 158 130)"/>
      <ellipse cx="160" cy="123" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#e8a0b8" transform="rotate(15 160 123)"/>
      <g transform="translate(130,140)">
        <ellipse cx="-8" cy="20" rx="12" ry="22" fill="#f0a0c0" transform="rotate(-15)"/>
        <ellipse cx="8" cy="20" rx="12" ry="22" fill="#e890b0" transform="rotate(15)"/>
        <ellipse cx="0" cy="18" rx="12" ry="22" fill="#f5b0cc"/>
        <ellipse cx="-18" cy="10" rx="12" ry="18" fill="#e890b0" transform="rotate(-55)"/>
        <ellipse cx="18" cy="10" rx="12" ry="18" fill="#f0a0c0" transform="rotate(55)"/>
        <ellipse cx="-20" cy="-8" rx="11" ry="18" fill="#f5b0cc" transform="rotate(-100)"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="5" r="7" fill="#fff5a0"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-5" y2="-8" stroke="#c8903a" stroke-width="1.2"/>

        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="5" y2="-8" stroke="#c8903a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        <circle cx="5" cy="-9" r="1.8" fill="#D4A843"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="-10" stroke="#c8903a" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="-11" r="1.8" fill="#D4A843"/>
        <circle cx="-3" cy="12" r="1" fill="#c8507a" opacity="0.5"/>
        <circle cx="5" cy="14" r="0.8" fill="#c8507a" opacity="0.5"/>
        <circle cx="-7" cy="8" r="0.8" fill="#c8507a" opacity="0.5"/>
        <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="1" fill="#c8507a" opacity="0.4"/>
      </g>
      <g transform="translate(105,118) scale(0.82)">
        <ellipse cx="-8" cy="20" rx="11" ry="20" fill="#f0a0c0" transform="rotate(-20)"/>
        <ellipse cx="8" cy="20" rx="11" ry="20" fill="#e890b0" transform="rotate(10)"/>

        <ellipse cx="-17" cy="8" rx="10" ry="17" fill="#e890b0" transform="rotate(-60)"/>
        <ellipse cx="17" cy="8" rx="10" ry="17" fill="#f0a0c0" transform="rotate(50)"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="4" r="6" fill="#fff5a0"/>

        <ellipse cx="-8" cy="20" rx="11" ry="20" fill="#d880a8" transform="rotate(-10)"/>

      <path d="M130 290 Q118 282 112 276 Q120 280 128 284 Q126 278 120 270 Q128 278 130 284 Q132 278 140 270 Q134 278 132 284 Q140 280 148 276 Q142 282 130 290Z" fill="#f08090" opacity="0.85"/>

    <div class="s1-sub">this is for u babe</div>
    <div class="s1-question">do you want to see what i made for you?</div>
    <div class="s1-btns">
      <button class="btn-yes" onclick="startYes()">YESSSSS</button>
      <button class="btn-no" onclick="showError()">no</button>

</div>

<!-- Error Overlay -->
<div id="error-overlay">
  <div class="error-box">
    <div class="error-title">ERROR: choice not available 😤😤😤</div>
    <div class="error-photo">😤</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;color:#888;font-size:0.9rem;">this option does not exist bestie</div>
    <button class="btn-fine" onclick="closeError()">okay FINE 🙄</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Petal Burst -->
<div id="petal-burst"></div>

<!-- ════════════════ SCREEN 3: BIRTHDAY ════════════════ -->
<div id="s3" class="screen">
  <!-- Balloons -->
  <div class="balloons-container">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 800" width="80" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:100%;animation:balloonFloat 3.5s ease-in-out infinite">
      <ellipse cx="30" cy="80" rx="22" ry="28" fill="#f9c8d4" opacity="0.9"/>
      <ellipse cx="28" cy="72" rx="6" ry="5" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"/>
      <path d="M30 108 Q32 140 28 160 Q30 200 35 240 Q30 280 28 300" stroke="#e8a0b4" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
      <ellipse cx="55" cy="160" rx="18" ry="23" fill="#c8d4f5" opacity="0.85"/>
      <ellipse cx="53" cy="153" rx="5" ry="4" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"/>
      <path d="M55 183 Q57 210 53 235" stroke="#a8b4e0" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
      <ellipse cx="25" cy="280" rx="20" ry="25" fill="#d4f0c8" opacity="0.8"/>
      <path d="M25 305 Q27 330 22 360" stroke="#a8d498" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
    </svg>

<!-- ════════════════ SCREEN 4b: CUT CAKE ════════════════ -->
<div id="s4b" class="screen">
  <div style="font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,6vw,3rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--blush);letter-spacing:0.1em;margin-bottom:0.5rem;">cut the cake 🎂</div>

<!-- ════════════════ SCREEN 6: ENVELOPE ════════════════ -->
<div id="s6" class="screen">
  <div class="env-wrap">

    <!-- Baby's breath – top left of envelope area -->
    <svg class="babys-breath" viewBox="0 0 140 80" width="140"
      style="top:calc(50% - 120px);left:calc(50% - 220px);z-index:5;opacity:0.9">
      <g fill="none" stroke="#6a8a5a" stroke-width="1.2">
        <path d="M10 75 Q30 45 65 28 Q90 18 120 8"/>
        <path d="M18 75 Q42 52 62 38 Q82 26 108 16"/>
        <path d="M28 76 Q48 58 64 46 Q78 36 96 28"/>
        <path d="M10 75 Q18 56 30 42 Q42 30 58 24"/>
        <path d="M65 28 Q70 15 76 8"/>

    <!-- Realistic envelope SVG (based on reference: textured, diagonal flap, postmarks, roses) -->
    <div class="env-outer" onclick="openLetter()" style="position:relative;">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," style="width:100%;border-radius:4px;display:block;" alt="envelope"/>
</div>

<!-- ════════════════ LETTER OVERLAY ════════════════ -->
<div id="letter-overlay" class="letter-overlay">
  <div class="letter-paper">
    <div class="letter-lines"></div>

    

    

    <div class="letter-inner">
      <div class="letter-date">May 2026 ✿</div>
      <div class="letter-body">Dear Sharss happiest 17th birthdayayay!!! 
i love you smmm twin and i love us.  its been so fun to be friends with you. we can talk litrally about anything. be it deep talk or bitching.  
i genuinely can share stuff with you.  you're such a beautiful person inside out. 
im sososo grateful we became friends during teen campppp.!!!! best memories. (PS - i cant write letters)
i hope you get everything you want. Wishing you the most magical year ahead.
love youuuuuuouuououu. mwahhhh</div>
      <div class="letter-sign">
        <span style="display:block;text-align:right;width:100%;padding-right:1rem;">- love Kani</span>
        <span class="kiss-mark">💋</span>
      </div>
      <div class="letter-actions">
        <button class="letter-close" onclick="closeLetter()">close ✕</button>
        <button class="restart-btn" onclick="restartAll()">🌸 go back to start</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ── NAVIGATION ──
function showScreen(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
}

// ── S1 ──
function showError() { document.getElementById('error-overlay').classList.add('show'); }
function closeError() { document.getElementById('error-overlay').classList.remove('show'); }

function startYes() {
  burstPetals();
  setTimeout(() => {
    showScreen('s3');
    initGlitter();
  }, 1800);
}

function burstPetals() {
  const burst = document.getElementById('petal-burst');
  burst.style.display = 'block';
  const colors = ['#f5b0cc','#e890b0','#f9d5dc','#c9a8d4','#f0c8d8','#ffd0e0'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'burst-petal';
    p.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw';
    p.style.top = '-30px';
    p.style.background = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
    p.style.transform = `rotate(${Math.random()*90}deg)`;
    p.style.animationDuration = (1.5 + Math.random() * 2) + 's';
    p.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * 0.8) + 's';
    burst.appendChild(p);
  }
  setTimeout(() => { burst.style.display = 'none'; burst.innerHTML = ''; }, 3000);
}

// ── GLITTER (S3) ──
function initGlitter() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('glitter-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
  canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
  const particles = Array.from({length:60}, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
    y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
    r: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
    speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1,
    color: ['#D4A843','#f9c8d4','#c9a8d4','#f5e0a0','#ffffff'][Math.floor(Math.random()*5)],
    alpha: Math.random()
  }));
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    particles.forEach(p => {
      ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha; ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
      p.alpha += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.06;
      p.alpha = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1, p.alpha));
      p.y -= p.speed * 0.3;
      if (p.y < -5) p.y = canvas.height + 5;
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  draw();
}

// ── S4: CAKE ──
let countdownActive = false;
let audioCtx = null;

function goToS4() { showScreen('s4'); startCountdown(); }

function startCountdown() {
  if (countdownActive) return;
  countdownActive = true;
  let t = 7;
  const numEl = document.getElementById('countdown-num');
  const circle = document.getElementById('countdown-circle');
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * 30;
  circle.style.strokeDasharray = circumference;
  circle.style.strokeDashoffset = 0;
  numEl.textContent = t;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    t--;
    numEl.textContent = t;
    circle.style.strokeDashoffset = circumference * (1 - t/7);
    if (t <= 0) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      extinguishCandles();
      playHappyBirthday();
      setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById('btn-cut').style.display = 'block'; }, 2000);
    }
  }, 1000);
}

function extinguishCandles() {
  const flames = document.getElementById('flames');
  if (flames) { flames.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s'; flames.style.opacity = '0'; }
}

function playHappyBirthday() {
  try {
    if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const g = audioCtx.createGain();
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, audioCtx.currentTime);
    g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    const hb = [
      [264,0.25],[264,0.25],[297,0.5],[264,0.5],[352,0.5],[330,1],
      [264,0.25],[264,0.25],[297,0.5],[264,0.5],[396,0.5],[352,1],
      [264,0.25],[264,0.25],[528,0.5],[440,0.5],[352,0.5],[330,0.5],[297,1],
      [470,0.25],[470,0.25],[440,0.5],[352,0.5],[396,0.5],[352,1]
    ];
    let t = audioCtx.currentTime;
    hb.forEach(([f,d]) => {
      const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const e = audioCtx.createGain();
      o.type = 'triangle'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t);
      e.gain.setValueAtTime(0.8, t);
      e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, t + d);
      o.connect(e); e.connect(g); o.start(t); o.stop(t + d);
      t += d;
    });
  } catch(e) {}
}

function goToS4b() { showScreen('s4b'); initCakeCanvas(); }

// ── CAKE CUTTING ──
let cutLines = [], isDrawing = false, lastPt = null, cakeCtx = null, cakeCut = false;

function initCakeCanvas() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('cake-canvas');
  const size = Math.min(window.innerWidth * 0.85, 300);
  canvas.width = size; canvas.height = size * 0.87;
  cakeCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  drawCakeOnCanvas(cakeCtx, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { isDrawing=true; lastPt=getPos(e,canvas); });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if(isDrawing) drawCut(e,canvas); });
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDrawing=false; checkCut(); });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); isDrawing=true; lastPt=getPos(e.touches[0],canvas); });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { e.preventDefault(); if(isDrawing) drawCut(e.touches[0],canvas); });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => { isDrawing=false; checkCut(); });
}

function getPos(e,canvas) { const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top}; }

function drawCakeOnCanvas(ctx,w,h) {
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f0d0e0'; ctx.beginPath(); roundRect(ctx,w*0.1,h*0.35,w*0.8,h*0.5,14); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#f5dce8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(w*0.5,h*0.35,w*0.4,h*0.1,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fffafc'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(w*0.5,h*0.35,w*0.4,h*0.1,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.font=`${w*0.1}px serif`; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('🌸',w*0.3,h*0.65); ctx.fillText('🌸',w*0.7,h*0.65); ctx.fillText('🌷',w*0.5,h*0.62);
  ctx.fillStyle='#c8547a'; ctx.font=`italic ${w*0.05}px 'Dancing Script',cursive`;
  ctx.fillText('Happy Birthday!',w*0.5,h*0.5);
}

function roundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r) {
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y); ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y); ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r); ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h); ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x,y+r); ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+r,y,r);
}

function drawCut(e,canvas) {
  const pt = getPos(e,canvas);
  if (!lastPt) { lastPt=pt; return; }
  cutLines.push({sx:lastPt.x,sy:lastPt.y,ex:pt.x,ey:pt.y});
  cakeCtx.strokeStyle='#8B4513'; cakeCtx.lineWidth=3;
  cakeCtx.shadowBlur=4; cakeCtx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
  cakeCtx.beginPath(); cakeCtx.moveTo(lastPt.x,lastPt.y); cakeCtx.lineTo(pt.x,pt.y); cakeCtx.stroke();
  cakeCtx.shadowBlur=0; lastPt=pt;
}

function checkCut() {
  if (!cakeCut && cutLines.length > 5) {
    const len = cutLines.reduce((s,l)=>s+Math.hypot(l.ex-l.sx,l.ey-l.sy),0);
    if (len > 40) { cakeCut=true; setTimeout(()=>showScreen('s5'),800); }
  }
}

// ── S6 ──
function goToS6() { showScreen('s6'); }
function openLetter() { document.getElementById('letter-overlay').classList.add('open'); }
function closeLetter() { document.getElementById('letter-overlay').classList.remove('open'); }

function restartAll() {
  closeLetter();
  countdownActive=false; cakeCut=false; cutLines=[];
  if(audioCtx){ try{audioCtx.close();}catch(e){} audioCtx=null; }
  const flames = document.getElementById('flames');
  if(flames){ flames.style.opacity='1'; flames.style.transition=''; }
  document.getElementById('btn-cut').style.display='none';
  showScreen('s1');
}

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  const c = document.getElementById('glitter-canvas');
  if(c){ c.width=c.offsetWidth; c.height=c.offsetHeight; }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
